description: Full registration record for a domain via RDAP (the modern WHOIS): registrar, creation/expiration/last-updated dates with days-to-expiry, nameservers, EPP statuses and DNSSEC. Straight from the authoritative registry — the data agents should cite for domain diligence. Use this when an agent needs to registrar, dates, nameservers — registry data. x402 price $0.003/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
